title: Persona 3 Reload [Switch 2]
description: Live through a school year in Port Island, build bonds and social stats by day, then explore Tartarus and fight Shadows during the Dark Hour. Persona 3 Reload modernizes the original with rebuilt visuals, interface, battle systems, extra scenes, and additional voice work.

description_short: A modern remake of Persona 3 combining daily school life, Social Links, Persona fusion, and turn-based battles in Tartarus.
description_ar: عِش عامًا دراسيًا في Port Island، وابنِ العلاقات وSocial Links وطوّر الإحصائيات الاجتماعية نهارًا، ثم استكشف Tartarus وقاتل الـShadows خلال Dark Hour. تعيد Persona 3 Reload بناء اللعبة الأصلية بصريًا وتحدّث الواجهة والقتال وتضيف مشاهد وأداءً صوتيًا إضافيًا.
nintendoNotes:
Nintendo platform: native Nintendo Switch 2 release on 2025-10-23. No Nintendo Switch 1 version. The physical Switch 2 version uses a Game-Key Card and therefore requires an internet download.

Supplier language selection: Simplified Chinese. Four supplier variants mapped by established rule: Regular=Offline Standard, Special=Offline DLC, Standard=Online Standard, Deluxe=Online DLC.
Supplier costs after platform subsidy: ¥14.64 / ¥16.6 / ¥163.6 / ¥173.4 => 3,000 / 3,500 / 35,750 / 38,000 IQD. Pre-discount values: ¥18 / ¥20 / ¥170 / ¥180.
Patch 1.03 adds a 60 fps Performance Mode in docked/TV mode and fixes frame-pacing issues; handheld remains 30 fps in Digital Foundry testing.
tagline: Dive into the Dark Hour and awaken the depths of your heart.
fitFor: Players who enjoy story-heavy turn-based RPGs
Fans of relationship and time-management systems
Players who like Persona fusion and party customization
Players who enjoy 60+ hour narrative RPGs
notFitFor: Players who want constant real-time action
Players who dislike long dialogue and calendar progression

gameplayPillars.title: Daily life and relationships
gameplayPillars.description: The calendar system makes time a resource: school, Social Links, activities, social-stat growth, and evening options compete for limited days and time slots.

gameplayPillars.title: Tartarus and turn-based combat
gameplayPillars.description: Battles emphasize elemental weaknesses, One More turns, Shift actions, Theurgy attacks, party roles, and Persona skills while Tartarus provides the main dungeon progression.

gameplayPillars.title: Persona fusion and growth
gameplayPillars.description: The protagonist can hold multiple Personas, fuse them into new forms, inherit skills, register them in the Compendium, and build specialized combat setups.

worldSummary: The game takes place primarily around Tatsumi Port Island, Gekkoukan High School, Iwatodai, and the supernatural Dark Hour. Tartarus is a towering labyrinth that appears during the hidden hour after midnight.

storyChapters.title: Arrival in Port Island
storyChapters.body: A transfer student arrives in Port Island, experiences the Dark Hour, awakens Persona power, and becomes involved with S.E.E.S.

storyChapters.title: The Dark Hour and S.E.E.S.
storyChapters.body: S.E.E.S. explores Tartarus and confronts Shadows while trying to understand the Dark Hour and the unusual events affecting the city.

storyChapters.title: Confronting mortality and fate
storyChapters.body: The story increasingly focuses on mortality, grief, bonds, personal responsibility, and the consequences of the group’s discoveries.

features: Daily calendar and Social Link progression
Turn-based combat with Shift and Theurgy systems
Large DLC catalog including Episode Aigis
perfNotes: Nintendo Switch 2 launch version targeted 30 fps. Patch 1.03 added a 60 fps Performance Mode for docked/TV play and corrected inconsistent frame pacing. Digital Foundry reports only small dips from 60 in that mode; handheld remains 30 fps.

handheld.notes: Handheld remains at 30 fps after patch 1.03; frame pacing was improved by the patch.

tv.notes: Patch 1.03 adds a 60 fps Performance Mode in docked/TV mode with small dips from target in measured testing.

devicePerformance.performanceNotes: Performance data reflects patch 1.03 testing. Input latency remains a noted issue in Digital Foundry’s analysis.

storageNotes: Nintendo Europe lists a 21.7 GB download. Physical copies are Game-Key Cards and require downloading the game data; package notices can require additional free space beyond the listed download size.

verdictSummary: A critically acclaimed modern remake with strong turn-based combat, relationship systems, presentation, and soundtrack. The Switch 2 port improved materially after patch 1.03 due to the new docked 60 fps mode and corrected frame pacing.
